What are the risks of taking a Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppy home before 8 weeks of age?
Experts, including the Kennel Club, universally recommend waiting until a puppy is at least eight weeks old.
Taking a puppy home prematurely can lead to lifelong behavioral issues such as anxiety, aggression, and an inability to socialise properly with other dogs.
